summary: Select BF16 or FP32 split partials for B12X dense MLA
compatibility: BF16 MLA partials remain the default. VLLM_K3_DENSE_MLA_PARTIAL_DTYPE=fp32 requires the B12X FP32-partials companion.
details: Passes the declared partial dtype to prepared B12X MLA plans.
Covers both partial dtypes in CUDA Graph replay with capacity changes and page addresses beyond the signed 32-bit offset boundary.
